description.value:
Always on (automated): +1 to Shooting Weapons and Throwing checks.

Action (once per scene): spend your Action on this technique; your next Shooting Weapons and Throwing check this scene gains a further +2.

Technique strike (automated): use the item to roll an attack (DEX modifier) and 1d6 + DEX modifier physical damage. Targets Defend or Dodge as normal.

Reskin freely as training, a perk, an implant, a technique, a gadget or a power.
